# W0301: unreachable arm

An earlier arm already matches every value that this one matches, so it never runs. Move it before that arm, or delete it.

- Rule: [`patterns.unreachable-arms`](../../reference/09-patterns.md#patterns.unreachable-arms)
- Reported at: the arm's pattern.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `warnings` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt W0301:4
fn label(n: i64) -> str {
  match n {
    _ => "any"
    0 => "zero"
  }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn label(n: i64) -> str {
  match n {
    0 => "zero"
    _ => "any"
  }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`W0301_unreachable_arm.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/W0301_unreachable_arm.lt):

```text
── UNREACHABLE ARM ─────────────────────── W0301_unreachable_arm.lt:4:5  [W0301]

The arms before this one match everything it matches:

  4 │     0 => "zero"
    │     ^

An earlier arm already matches every value that this one matches, so it never
runs. Move it before that arm, or delete it.

To fix it, delete the arm:

  4 │     0 => "zero"
    │     -----------
```
